properties.name: color
properties.description: The colour of the text.

properties.name: font-family
properties.description: The fonts to use, in order. The first font that has a character draws it.

properties.name: font-size
properties.description: The size of the text.

properties.name: font-style
properties.description: Whether the text is upright or italic.

properties.name: font-weight
properties.description: How thick the letters are, from 1 to 1000. `bold` is 700.

properties.name: font-variant
properties.description: Draws lower-case letters as small capitals.

properties.name: font-feature-settings
properties.description: Turns OpenType features of the font on or off, such as figures of equal width.

properties.name: font
properties.description: Sets the style, weight, size, line height and fonts in one declaration.

properties.name: line-height
properties.description: The height of one line of text. A number multiplies the font size.

properties.name: text-align
properties.description: How lines are placed between the left and right edges of their box.

properties.name: text-align-last
properties.description: How the last line of a paragraph is placed.

properties.name: text-indent
properties.description: The space before the first line of a paragraph.

properties.name: text-decoration-line
properties.description: Draws a line under, over or through the text.

properties.name: text-decoration-style
properties.description: The style of the decoration line.

properties.name: text-decoration-color
properties.description: The colour of the decoration line.

properties.name: text-decoration
properties.description: Sets the decoration line, its style and its colour in one declaration.

properties.name: text-transform
properties.description: Draws the text in upper case, lower case or with capital first letters.

properties.name: letter-spacing
properties.description: Extra space between letters.

properties.name: word-spacing
properties.description: Extra space between words.

properties.name: white-space
properties.description: Whether spaces and line breaks in the HTML are kept, and whether lines wrap.

properties.name: word-break
properties.description: Where a line may break inside a word.

properties.name: overflow-wrap
properties.description: Breaks a word that is too long for its line.

properties.name: text-overflow
properties.description: Ends text that does not fit with `…`.

properties.name: vertical-align
properties.description: How an inline box or a table cell is placed vertically. A cell takes `top`, `middle`, `bottom` or `baseline`.

properties.name: direction
properties.description: Whether text runs from left to right or from right to left.

properties.name: unicode-bidi
properties.description: How a box mixes left-to-right and right-to-left text.

properties.name: hyphens
properties.description: With `auto`, long words break with a hyphen, by the rules of the `lang` language.

properties.name: margin-top
properties.description: The space above the box.

properties.name: margin-right
properties.description: The space to the right of the box.

properties.name: margin-bottom
properties.description: The space below the box.

properties.name: margin-left
properties.description: The space to the left of the box.

properties.name: margin
properties.description: Sets the four margins in one declaration.

properties.name: padding-top
properties.description: The space between the top border and the content.

properties.name: padding-right
properties.description: The space between the right border and the content.

properties.name: padding-bottom
properties.description: The space between the bottom border and the content.

properties.name: padding-left
properties.description: The space between the left border and the content.

properties.name: padding
properties.description: Sets the four paddings in one declaration.

properties.name: border-top-width
properties.description: The thickness of the top border.

properties.name: border-right-width
properties.description: The thickness of the right border.

properties.name: border-bottom-width
properties.description: The thickness of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-left-width
properties.description: The thickness of the left border.

properties.name: border-top-style
properties.description: The style of the top border: solid, dashed, dotted or double.

properties.name: border-right-style
properties.description: The style of the right border.

properties.name: border-bottom-style
properties.description: The style of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-left-style
properties.description: The style of the left border.

properties.name: border-top-color
properties.description: The colour of the top border.

properties.name: border-right-color
properties.description: The colour of the right border.

properties.name: border-bottom-color
properties.description: The colour of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-left-color
properties.description: The colour of the left border.

properties.name: border-width
properties.description: Sets the thickness of the four borders in one declaration.

properties.name: border-style
properties.description: Sets the style of the four borders in one declaration.

properties.name: border-color
properties.description: Sets the colour of the four borders in one declaration.

properties.name: border
properties.description: Sets the thickness, style and colour of all four borders.

properties.name: border-top
properties.description: Sets the thickness, style and colour of the top border.

properties.name: border-right
properties.description: Sets the thickness, style and colour of the right border.

properties.name: border-bottom
properties.description: Sets the thickness, style and colour of the bottom border.

properties.name: border-left
properties.description: Sets the thickness, style and colour of the left border.

properties.name: border-top-left-radius
properties.description: How round the top left corner is.

properties.name: border-top-right-radius
properties.description: How round the top right corner is.

properties.name: border-bottom-right-radius
properties.description: How round the bottom right corner is.

properties.name: border-bottom-left-radius
properties.description: How round the bottom left corner is.

properties.name: border-radius
properties.description: Sets how round the four corners are in one declaration.

properties.name: width
properties.description: The width of the box.

properties.name: height
properties.description: The height of the box.

properties.name: min-width
properties.description: The smallest width the box may have.

properties.name: min-height
properties.description: The smallest height the box may have.

properties.name: max-width
properties.description: The largest width the box may have.

properties.name: max-height
properties.description: The largest height the box may have.

properties.name: box-sizing
properties.description: Whether `width` and `height` include the padding and the border.

properties.name: background-color
properties.description: The colour behind the box's content.

properties.name: background-image
properties.description: An image or a gradient behind the box's content.

properties.name: background-repeat
properties.description: Whether the background image repeats to fill the box.

properties.name: background-position
properties.description: Where the background image is placed in the box.

properties.name: background-size
properties.description: The size of the background image.

properties.name: background
properties.description: Sets the background colour, image, repeat, position and size in one declaration.

properties.name: outline-width
properties.description: The thickness of the outline, a line drawn outside the border.

properties.name: outline-style
properties.description: The style of the outline.

properties.name: outline-color
properties.description: The colour of the outline.

properties.name: outline-offset
properties.description: The space between the border and the outline.

properties.name: outline
properties.description: Sets the thickness, style and colour of the outline.

properties.name: opacity
properties.description: How opaque the box is, from 0 (invisible) to 1.

properties.name: display
properties.description: How the box is laid out: as a block, inline, a flex or grid container, a table part, or not at all with `none`.

properties.name: visibility
properties.description: With `hidden`, the box takes its space and draws nothing.

properties.name: overflow-x
properties.description: Whether content wider than the box is cut off.

properties.name: overflow-y
properties.description: Whether content taller than the box is cut off.

properties.name: overflow
properties.description: Sets both overflow directions in one declaration.

properties.name: list-style-type
properties.description: The marker of a list item: a disc, a number, a Roman numeral or a letter.

properties.name: list-style-position
properties.description: Whether the marker is inside or outside the item's box.

properties.name: list-style-image
properties.description: An image used as the marker.

properties.name: list-style
properties.description: Sets the marker, its position and its image in one declaration.

properties.name: counter-reset
properties.description: Creates a counter or sets it back to a number.

properties.name: counter-increment
properties.description: Adds to a counter each time the element appears.

properties.name: content
properties.description: The text that `::before` and `::after` add, or what a margin box prints.

properties.name: object-fit
properties.description: How an image fills its box: stretched, fitted inside, or covering it.

properties.name: object-position
properties.description: Where an image is placed in its box.

properties.name: flex-direction
properties.description: Whether a flex container places its items in a row or a column.

properties.name: flex-wrap
properties.description: Whether flex items move to a new line when they do not fit.

properties.name: flex-flow
properties.description: Sets the direction and the wrapping in one declaration.

properties.name: flex-grow
properties.description: How much of the free space a flex item takes.

properties.name: flex-shrink
properties.description: How much a flex item shrinks when there is not enough space.

properties.name: flex-basis
properties.description: The size of a flex item before the free space is shared.

properties.name: flex
properties.description: Sets grow, shrink and basis in one declaration.

properties.name: order
properties.description: The position of a flex or grid item among its siblings.

properties.name: justify-content
properties.description: How a flex or grid container shares free space along the main direction.

properties.name: align-content
properties.description: How a container shares free space between its lines or rows.

properties.name: align-items
properties.description: How items are placed across the main direction.

properties.name: justify-items
properties.description: How grid items are placed in their cells, along the row.

properties.name: align-self
properties.description: How one item is placed across the main direction.

properties.name: justify-self
properties.description: How one grid item is placed in its cell, along the row.

properties.name: row-gap
properties.description: The space between rows.

properties.name: column-gap
properties.description: The space between columns.

properties.name: gap
properties.description: Sets the row gap and the column gap in one declaration.

properties.name: grid-template-columns
properties.description: The widths of a grid's columns.

properties.name: grid-template-rows
properties.description: The heights of a grid's rows.

properties.name: grid-template-areas
properties.description: Names areas of a grid, one string per row.

properties.name: grid-auto-columns
properties.description: The width of a column the grid adds by itself.

properties.name: grid-auto-rows
properties.description: The height of a row the grid adds by itself.

properties.name: grid-auto-flow
properties.description: Whether the grid places items row by row or column by column.

properties.name: grid-row
properties.description: The rows a grid item covers.

properties.name: grid-column
properties.description: The columns a grid item covers.

properties.name: grid-area
properties.description: The named area a grid item is placed in.

properties.name: float
properties.description: Moves the box to the left or right, and the text beside it wraps around it.

properties.name: clear
properties.description: Moves the box below the floats before it.

properties.name: position
properties.description: How the box is placed: in the flow, moved from its place, against a container, on every page, or as a running header with `running(name)`.

properties.name: top
properties.description: The distance from the top edge of the containing box.

properties.name: right
properties.description: The distance from the right edge of the containing box.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: The distance from the bottom edge of the containing box.

properties.name: left
properties.description: The distance from the left edge of the containing box.

properties.name: inset
properties.description: Sets `top`, `right`, `bottom` and `left` in one declaration.

properties.name: z-index
properties.description: Which positioned box is drawn on top. A higher number is drawn later.

properties.name: transform
properties.description: Moves, scales, rotates or skews the box in two dimensions.

properties.name: transform-origin
properties.description: The point a transform turns and scales around.

properties.name: size
properties.description: In `@page`, the size and orientation of the page.

properties.name: page
properties.description: Puts the element on pages of a named `@page` rule.

properties.name: string-set
properties.description: Saves the element's text under a name, for `string()` in a margin box.

properties.name: break-before
properties.description: Starts a new page before the element, or avoids a break there.

properties.name: break-after
properties.description: Starts a new page after the element, or avoids a break there.

properties.name: break-inside
properties.description: With `avoid`, the element is not split across two pages when it fits on one.

properties.name: page-break-before
properties.description: The older syntax of `break-before`.

properties.name: page-break-after
properties.description: The older syntax of `break-after`.

properties.name: page-break-inside
properties.description: The older syntax of `break-inside`.

properties.name: orphans
properties.description: The fewest lines of a paragraph left at the bottom of a page.

properties.name: widows
properties.description: The fewest lines of a paragraph carried to the top of the next page.

properties.name: border-collapse
properties.description: Whether neighbouring table cells share one border.

properties.name: border-spacing
properties.description: The space between the borders of table cells that do not share one.

properties.name: caption-side
properties.description: Whether a table's caption is above or below it.

properties.name: empty-cells
properties.description: Whether the borders and background of an empty cell are drawn.

properties.name: table-layout
properties.description: With `fixed`, column widths come from the first row and the set widths only. A table with no `width` ignores `fixed`.

properties.name: box-decoration-break
properties.description: A box split across pages is cut, and its border is open where it continues.

functions.name: var()
functions.description: The value of a custom property, such as `var(--brand)`, with an optional value to use when it is not set.

functions.name: calc()
functions.description: Computes a length from other lengths, such as `calc(100% - 2cm)`.

functions.name: url()
functions.description: An image or a file, by its name in the asset map or as a `data:` URI.

functions.name: rgb()
functions.description: A colour from red, green and blue, with an optional alpha.

functions.name: hsl()
functions.description: A colour from hue, saturation and lightness, with an optional alpha.

functions.name: linear-gradient()
functions.description: A background that changes from one colour to another along a line.

functions.name: radial-gradient()
functions.description: A background that changes from one colour to another outwards from a point.

functions.name: counter()
functions.description: The current number of a counter. `counter(page)` and `counter(pages)` are the page number and the page count.

functions.name: counters()
functions.description: The numbers of a nested counter joined by a separator, such as `2.1.3`.

functions.name: string()
functions.description: In a margin box, the text saved by `string-set`.

functions.name: running()
functions.description: In `position`, takes the element out of the flow to repeat it in a margin box.

functions.name: element()
functions.description: In a margin box, places the element taken out by `running()`.

functions.name: target-counter()
functions.description: The page number of the element a link points to, for a table of contents.

functions.name: leader()
functions.description: Fills the space before a page number with dots, for a table of contents.

atRules.name: @media
atRules.description: Applies its rules to `print` and `all`. Rules for `screen` are not applied.

atRules.name: @page
atRules.description: The size and margins of the pages. `:first`, `:left`, `:right`, `:blank` and a name choose the pages it applies to.

atRules.name: @font-face
atRules.description: A font from the asset map.

atRules.name: @import
atRules.description: Adds a stylesheet from the asset map.

atRules.name: @top-left-corner
atRules.description: In `@page`, the box in the top left corner of the page.

atRules.name: @top-left
atRules.description: In `@page`, the left box of the top margin.

atRules.name: @top-center
atRules.description: In `@page`, the middle box of the top margin.

atRules.name: @top-right
atRules.description: In `@page`, the right box of the top margin.

atRules.name: @top-right-corner
atRules.description: In `@page`, the box in the top right corner of the page.

atRules.name: @right-top
atRules.description: In `@page`, the top box of the right margin.

atRules.name: @right-middle
atRules.description: In `@page`, the middle box of the right margin.

atRules.name: @right-bottom
atRules.description: In `@page`, the bottom box of the right margin.

atRules.name: @bottom-right-corner
atRules.description: In `@page`, the box in the bottom right corner of the page.

atRules.name: @bottom-right
atRules.description: In `@page`, the right box of the bottom margin.

atRules.name: @bottom-center
atRules.description: In `@page`, the middle box of the bottom margin.

atRules.name: @bottom-left
atRules.description: In `@page`, the left box of the bottom margin.

atRules.name: @bottom-left-corner
atRules.description: In `@page`, the box in the bottom left corner of the page.

atRules.name: @left-bottom
atRules.description: In `@page`, the bottom box of the left margin.

atRules.name: @left-middle
atRules.description: In `@page`, the middle box of the left margin.

atRules.name: @left-top
atRules.description: In `@page`, the top box of the left margin.

selectors.description: Every element.

selectors.name: p
selectors.description: Every element of that name.

selectors.name: .name
selectors.description: Every element with that class.

selectors.name: #name
selectors.description: The element with that `id`.

selectors.name: [attr]
selectors.description: Every element with that attribute. `=`, `~=`, `|=`, `^=`, `$=` and `*=` test its value.

selectors.name: a b
selectors.description: Every `b` inside an `a`.

selectors.name: a > b
selectors.description: Every `b` directly inside an `a`.

selectors.name: a + b
selectors.description: Every `b` directly after an `a`.

selectors.name: a ~ b
selectors.description: Every `b` after an `a` with the same parent.

selectors.name: :root
selectors.description: The `<html>` element.

selectors.name: :first-child
selectors.description: The first element in its parent.

selectors.name: :last-child
selectors.description: The last element in its parent.

selectors.name: :only-child
selectors.description: An element with no siblings.

selectors.name: :nth-child()
selectors.description: Elements by their position in the parent, such as `:nth-child(2n)` for every second one.

selectors.name: :nth-last-child()
selectors.description: Elements by their position, counted from the end.

selectors.name: :first-of-type
selectors.description: The first element of its name in its parent.

selectors.name: :last-of-type
selectors.description: The last element of its name in its parent.

selectors.name: :only-of-type
selectors.description: The only element of its name in its parent.

selectors.name: :nth-of-type()
selectors.description: Elements by their position among the siblings of the same name.

selectors.name: :nth-last-of-type()
selectors.description: The same as `:nth-of-type()`, counted from the end.

selectors.name: :empty
selectors.description: An element with no content.

selectors.name: :not()
selectors.description: Every element the selectors in the brackets do not match.

selectors.name: ::before
selectors.description: Content added at the start of the element by `content`.

selectors.name: ::after
selectors.description: Content added at the end of the element by `content`.

html.name: data-repeat
html.description: On a header or footer row of a table, says on which pages the row is shown. `every` is the default. `first` and `last` show it only on the first or the last page of the table. `continued` shows it only where the table goes on from the page before or to the next page.

html.name: data-mark
html.description: Gives the page a mark as `name:value`. A header or footer function reads the marks of its page.

html.name: slot
html.description: A `<slot name>` element is filled when the page is known, such as with a running total.

html.name: href
html.description: A link to an `http:`, `https:` or `mailto:` address, or to an element of the document with `#id`.

html.name: title
html.description: The `<title>` element is the document's title in the PDF.

html.name: meta
html.description: `<meta name="author">`, `description` and `keywords` become the PDF's metadata.

html.name: lang
html.description: The language of the text. It chooses the hyphenation rules.
